hint: The bronze altar is made from the bronze πυρεῖα of the men who rose in faction with Korah's company.

notes.text: Possession: were to the men, without the imperfect's formula.
The name stands between the article and its noun. The noun's unit takes the article and the name follows, as at 36:4.

notes.text: The singular: the piece of wood, the gloss being the plural's only mostly.

notes.text: The genitive absolute; the participle without the article, of going into.
